propositions: The review-bot service must be repointed from direct Anthropic API to Bedrock inference profiles as the exclusive provider, with no cross-provider fallback, to dogfood the Bedrock path that clients predominantly use

The per-pass model split (opus for Pass-1, sonnet for Pass-2/Pass-4) must be preserved across the cutover by configuring distinct class-slot environment variables rather than a single REBAR_LLM_MODEL knob

The review-bot container image must be rebuilt with the bedrock extra installed so pydantic_ai.providers.bedrock imports successfully at runtime, or the first Bedrock call will fail with LLMConfigError

A Bedrock InvokeModel client-error alarm must be declared, applied, and proven healthy on real data before the class-slot flip takes effect, to provide observability for provider-specific failures that the existing VOTER_ERROR alarm cannot detect

The kill switch must be proven end-to-end before cutover: the induced-VOTER_ERROR alarm transition observed on the Anthropic path, Bedrock IAM denial drilled with fail-closed blocking verified, and restoration with real Anthropic-path vote confirmed

Post-cutover observation must verify every LLM call routes to a bedrock: inference profile, zero direct-Anthropic calls, and prompt caching engages, via per-call REBAR_USAGE_LOG tally recorded to a durable path
